locations_lk.summary: PARK — OpenAQ v3 now requires a registered API key: confirmed 401 "A valid API key must be provided in the X-API-Key header" (verified 2026-09-14). This is a real API policy change, not a broken URL. Needs a product decision + user action to un-park: (1) register a free key at openaq.org, (2) add it as a GitHub Actions repo secret, (3) probe.py's generic harness would need to support injecting a secret-sourced header per endpoint (it currently only supports static headers from this YAML, which can't safely hold a key in a public repo). Not doing this unilaterally since it needs the user's own account/key.
